blurb: LA-based writer, director, artist, and partner at Asteria Films. Known for experimenting with AI tools like OpenAI's DALL-E 2 and RunwayML to create surreal, fluid visual art, often blending architecture and animation. His work explores the intersection of AI and filmmaking, with viral threads demonstrating techniques like outpainting and frame interpolation.
